newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian firms see Q3 profits falling - ABS.
newsitem.headline: Australian firms see Q3 profits falling - ABS.

text.p: Australian businesses expect profits to fall 1.4 percent in the September quarter from the previous quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
This compared with an expected 7.8 percent rise in profits in the June quarter and a 4.2 percent rise in the corresponding quarter of last year, the bureau said.
Selling prices are expected to rise 0.1 percent after a 0.3 percent rise in the previous quarter and a 0.2 percent rise in the September quarter last year, the bureau said.
Businesses expected sales to rise 0.7 percent in the coming quarter, well down on the 1.6 percent increase in the June quarter and the 1.6 percent rise a year ago.

The bureau's survey differs from other business expectations series in that it calculates the volume of expected movements as well as the direction. It does this by asking respondents for the size of expected movements and then weighting the results for the respondent's size.
Each survey, conducted in the middle month of each quarter, asks for expectations for the following quarter.
